name: circuit-platform
description: 简易数字电路仿真桌面应用

scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @circuit-platform/protocol test && pnpm --filter @circuit-platform/desktop test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm build:engine && pnpm test:engine
scripts.package:prepare: node scripts/release-version.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm build:engine
scripts.package:dir: pnpm package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --dir --publish never && pnpm package:check
scripts.package:win: pnpm package:prepare && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --publish never && pnpm package:check
